verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides GitHub Actions-compatible CI/CD workflows written in YAML that can reuse existing Actions. Webhooks, the API, and integrations such as Drone, Woodpecker and Jenkins let users build custom automated workflows that run without manual intervention. The evidence frames these as conventional CI/CD and event hooks, not agentic background automation, and the documentation is thin marketing copy. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/cron or long-running background triggers, AI/agent-driven automation support, in-depth docs on runners and execution, and hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions.
